PROPOSED BOUNDED BEAD — make reference-scope handle documentation Scala examples without aborting or inventing module scope. Reproduced at approved docs successor 8a227832 over e584ad6: `bash tools/reference-scope.sh e584ad6 8a227832` exits 1 with no output. The first changed Scala file is docs-site/examples/InspectSource.scala, which has an `@main` definition and no uppercase class/trait/object/type declaration; its grep pipeline returns 1 under `set -euo pipefail`, aborting the surrounding type-extraction command substitution. Seven of eight changed examples have this shape. A bare `|| true` would stop the abort but still misclassify docs-site/examples/PublicAlignAndInterpret.scala as a library type, then fail EMPTY SCOPE. Proposed semantics: extract candidate definitions only from module source trees (`*/src/**/*.scala`), matching the script's stated main-and-test source domain; tolerate a changed/deleted source file that defines no uppercase type; keep the existing empty-consumer refusal for real module types. Exact paths: tools/reference-scope.sh plus one new shell regression court under tools; no AGENTS.md, module, dependency, or public vocabulary change. Court cases: docs-only `@main` candidate exits 0 with no module types; mixed module type plus docs example still names the real consumer; deleted/no-declaration module source does not abort; real unreferenced module type still exits 3. Mutation proof should kill removal of the source-tree filter and removal of no-match tolerance. I volunteer to implement this slice if the chief assigns it.

set.title: reference-scope: handle @main-only docs examples without aborting
